authority: shipped decompiled source/XAML and expanded module XML; no vendor types instantiated
selectionRules: Installed original binding property is DisplayType, not DisplayTypeA. NameValueItem getter uses runtime GetType().Name; setter is empty.
Derived source overrides may change template key (SaveFileDialog->Command, OpenFolderDialog->OpenFileDialog, EnumerationLightForLight->EnumerationLight).
Explicit API displayType means an already evaluated native model DisplayType or ParamUserControl.ExternDisplayType; it is not a raw XML property override.
ParamUserControl ExternDisplayType uses non-null string even if empty. Otherwise bind model DisplayType.
Original UserTempConverter does exact case-sensitive ResourceDictionary lookup; missing keys use native Default DataTemplate; existing non-DataTemplate keys cast to null.
Independent catalog reports unknown entries Unsupported with no selected TemplateKey. NativeFallbackKey describes evidence only, never an instruction to create a generic TextBox.
Original local dictionary entries win over merged dictionaries. External merged providers/load order must remain explicit.
Recognized means template-selection metadata is known; it does not prove an independent renderer exists or that source/runtime behavior is fully reproduced.
limits: Coverage includes declared XML Items and recursively linked groups, not every runtime-created custom control child.
Custom-template dependencies are recorded per DataTemplate; external object creation/interaction is not executed.
Literal controls and data kinds are not used to infer an editor. No window/view implementation is added.
